name: Kusama Reito
source:
"No, please stop that..."

High school 2nd-year.

He is in charge of the drums in the light music club. He looks cold-hearted at first glance but is much more warm in reality. He's one of the best-tempered members in the club and is good at taking care of his underclassmen.

[Translated from [url=https://d10rama.com/nitousei/]official website[/url]]
